text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Four Forces on an Airplane. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: sections Weight, Lift, Drag, Thrust.
text.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）格伦研究中心《飞机上的四种力》（Four Forces on an Airplane），航空入门指南：重力、升力、阻力、推力各小节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Lift, weight, thrust and drag; weight acts towards the centre of the Earth and depends on the aircraft, its fuel and payload; lift is perpendicular to the flight direction and drag opposes the motion; in steady level flight with no bank and horizontal thrust, lift equals weight and thrust equals drag, and the aircraft keeps moving at constant speed; a glider has no engine and still flies; on a conventional airliner the wings provide most of the lift and the engines the thrust. Paraphrased, no quotation.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。升力、重力、推力、阻力；重力朝地心，取决于飞机、燃油和载荷；升力垂直于飞行方向，阻力阻碍运动；在无倾斜、推力水平的稳定水平飞行中，升力等于重力、推力等于阻力，飞机保持匀速运动；滑翔机没有发动机也能飞；常规客机的大部分升力来自机翼，推力来自发动机。转述，无引文。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Bernoulli and Newton. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: sections “Which camp is correct?” and “What is the argument?”.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《伯努利与牛顿》（Bernoulli and Newton），航空入门指南：“哪一派是对的”与“争论是什么”两节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Integrating the pressure over the surface and working out the change in the air’s momentum are two consistent ways of calculating the same aerodynamic force, not two lifts to be added; the “equal transit time” story is wrong because air passing above and below has no need to meet again at the trailing edge; both surfaces turn the flow, so an explanation using only air hitting the lower surface is incomplete. Paraphrased.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。对表面气压求积分和计算空气动量的变化，是计算同一个空气动力的两种一致方法，不是两份升力相加；“等时到达”的说法是错的，从上下两侧经过的空气不必在后缘重新会合；上下表面都使气流转向，只说空气撞击下表面的解释不完整。转述。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Fluid Dynamics Interactive (FoilInc). Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: sections Angle of Attack, Lift, Wing Stall, Plot.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《流体力学互动》（Fluid Dynamics Interactive），航空入门指南：迎角、升力、机翼失速、曲线图各节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Angle of attack is measured between the chord line and the oncoming flow; at small angles lift generally increases with angle; at larger angles the flow can separate from the surface, the wing stalls and lift falls; the angle at which this happens has to be found for each wing and set of conditions, by matching test conditions and experiment; in ideal flow a symmetric airfoil at zero angle has no lift, a cambered one can. The stall-versus-engine distinction in this topic is a teaching paraphrase of the page’s definition of wing stall.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。迎角在翼弦与来流之间量；小迎角时升力一般随迎角增加；迎角较大时气流可能从表面分离，机翼失速，升力下降；出现失速的角度要针对每种机翼和工况，在相似条件下由实验确定；理想流中对称翼型零迎角没有升力，弯翼型可以有。本主题“失速不是发动机停转”的说法，是根据该页对机翼失速的定义所作的教学转述。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Lift Equation. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: sections Lift Coefficient and Flow Conditions.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《升力方程》（Lift Equation），航空入门指南：升力系数、流动条件两节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. L = ½ ρ V² S Cl, with ρ the air density, V the speed relative to the air, S a reference area and Cl a lift coefficient that gathers the effects of shape, angle of attack and flow conditions. That doubling V with ρ, S and Cl fixed gives four times the lift is this topic’s algebra from the equation, not a sentence of the page.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。L = ½ ρ V² S Cl：ρ 为空气密度，V 为相对空气的速度，S 为参考面积，Cl 为升力系数，包含形状、迎角和流动条件的影响。“ρ、S、Cl 不变时速度加倍，升力变为四倍”是本主题由该方程推出的代数结论，不是该页原句。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Ailerons. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《副翼》（Ailerons），航空入门指南。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Ailerons near the outer trailing edges of the wings move in opposite directions, rolling the aircraft into a bank; banking tilts the lift, whose sideways part curves the flight path.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。副翼位于两翼外侧后缘，朝相反方向偏转，使飞机滚转、倾斜；倾斜使升力倾斜，其侧向分量让航迹弯曲。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Aircraft Elevator Interactive. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: section on the wing and horizontal tail.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《飞机升降舵互动》（Aircraft Elevator Interactive），航空入门指南：机翼与水平尾翼一节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. The elevator is a hinged part of the horizontal tail and changes pitch (nose up or down). The page also shows the Wright brothers’ forward elevator; this topic uses the conventional rear tail.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。升降舵是水平尾翼上可偏转的部分，改变俯仰（机头向上或向下）。该页也介绍了莱特兄弟装在前方的升降舵；本主题采用常规的后置尾翼。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Rudder Interactive. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: sections Vertical Stabilizer and Rudder.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《方向舵互动》（Rudder Interactive），航空入门指南：垂直安定面、方向舵两节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. The rudder is hinged to the vertical tail and controls yaw; in a coordinated turn it helps keep the aircraft lined up with its curving path. The page’s absolute statement that the rudder does not turn the aircraft is not repeated.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。方向舵铰接在垂直尾翼上，控制偏航；协调转弯时帮助飞机对准弯曲的航迹。该页“方向舵绝不使飞机转弯”的绝对说法本主题不采用。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Flaps and Slats Interactive. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: sections Flaps and Slats, Spoilers.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《襟翼与缝翼互动》（Flaps and Slats Interactive），航空入门指南：襟翼与缝翼、扰流板两节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Flaps on the trailing edge and slats on the leading edge change the shape of the wing, and designs that slide out also change its area, so that the wing gives more lift at lower speed; deployed flaps also add drag. Spoilers on the upper surface reduce lift and add drag, and are not flaps.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。后缘襟翼和前缘缝翼改变机翼形状，向外滑出的设计还改变面积，让机翼在较低速度下产生更多升力；放下的襟翼也增加阻力。上表面的扰流板减少升力、增加阻力，与襟翼不同。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Turbofan Engine (last updated 13 May 2021).
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《涡扇发动机》（Turbofan Engine，2021 年 5 月 13 日更新）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Air enters through the inlet; the fan sends part of it through the core and part around it (the bypass); in the core the air is compressed, fuel is added and burned, and the hot gas passes through turbines and out of a nozzle; the turbines drive the compressor and the fan through shafts; in the two-spool example the fan shaft passes through the inside of the core shaft; other engines can have more spools; bypass air does not pass through the combustor or turbines; both the core exhaust and the fan’s bypass air produce thrust; the bypass ratio is the ratio of the mass flow of air around the core to the mass flow through it. The interactive model in this topic follows this topology; it has no engine performance numbers.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。空气从进气口进入；风扇把一部分送进核心，一部分绕过核心（外涵）；在核心里，空气先被压缩，再加入燃料燃烧，热气经过涡轮后从喷口排出；涡轮经轴带动压气机和风扇；在两转子的例子里，风扇轴从核心轴内部穿过；其他发动机可能有更多转子；外涵空气不经过燃烧室和涡轮；核心排气和风扇推动的外涵空气都产生推力；涵道比是绕过核心与穿过核心的空气质量流量之比。本主题的交互模型按这一拓扑绘制，不含发动机性能数据。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Student Airfoil Interactive (FoilSim Student). Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: General Instructions, Graphics and Output, Analysis options.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《学生翼型互动》（FoilSim Student），航空入门指南：使用说明、图形与输出、分析选项。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. NASA’s teaching program shows streamlines, moving traces, surface pressure and plots of lift against chosen variables; its results come from ideal two-dimensional flow with a separate stall correction added on top. This topic follows that teaching form only; no code, coordinates or default thresholds were taken from it.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。NASA 的教学程序可显示流线、移动示踪点、表面气压以及升力随所选变量变化的曲线；它的结果来自理想二维流，另加一个独立的失速修正。本主题只参照这种教学形式，没有取用它的代码、坐标或默认阈值。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Earth Atmosphere Model – Metric Units (last updated 13 May 2021).
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《地球大气模型（公制）》（Earth Atmosphere Model – Metric Units，2021 年 5 月 13 日更新）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Curve fits to average measurements, in which pressure and density fall with height. Troposphere (used here, 0 to 10,000 m): T = 15.04 − 0.00649 h (°C, h in metres); p = 101.29 × [(T + 273.1) / 288.08]^5.256 (kPa); ρ = p / [0.2869 × (T + 273.1)] (kg/m³). All constants are used as printed. Results in this topic: ρ = 1.227 kg/m³ at 0 m, 0.738 at 5,000 m and 0.414 at 10,000 m. It is an average model, not a forecast of the weather on any day.

text.en: Airbus. Control your speed… in cruise. Safety First, January 2016: opening section and the sections on speed and altitude limits.
text.zh: 空中客车公司《控制你的速度……巡航中》（Control your speed… in cruise），Safety First，2016 年 1 月：开头及速度、高度限制各节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Choosing cruise speed and altitude balances fuel use and aircraft performance with weather and air traffic control; available thrust and the margins of the flight envelope limit how high an aircraft can usefully fly. Used only for this qualitative trade-off; no speeds, altitudes or operating advice are taken from it.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。选择巡航速度和高度，要在燃油、飞机性能与天气、空中交通管制之间取舍；可用推力和飞行包线的余量限制飞机能有效飞多高。本主题只采用这一定性的取舍，不取用其中任何速度、高度或操作建议。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Wing Geometry. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: Top View and the definitions of chord, span and airfoil.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《机翼几何》（Wing Geometry），航空入门指南：俯视图及翼弦、翼展、翼型的定义。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Leading and trailing edges, the chord line between them, the span, and the airfoil as the cross-section shape of the wing. Not used on its own for the job of spars and ribs (that is S43).
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。前缘与后缘、两者之间的翼弦、翼展，以及翼型作为机翼剖面形状的定义。翼梁与翼肋的作用不单靠本来源，见 S43。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Drag Equation. Beginner’s Guide to Aeronautics: sections Drag Coefficient and Reference Area.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《阻力方程》（Drag Equation），航空入门指南：阻力系数、参考面积两节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. D = ½ ρ V² S Cd. With Cd, V and S fixed, lower density gives less drag; this is algebra from the equation and is not a statement about the total drag of a real aircraft trimmed for cruise. The model in this topic does not calculate drag.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。D = ½ ρ V² S Cd。Cd、V、S 不变时，密度越小阻力越小；这是由方程推出的代数结论，不代表真实飞机在巡航配平时的总阻力。本主题的模型不计算阻力。

text.en: US National Park Service, Wright Brothers National Memorial. 1903 – The First Flight.
text.zh: 美国国家公园管理局莱特兄弟国家纪念地《1903：第一次飞行》（1903 – The First Flight）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. On 17 December 1903, near Kill Devil Hills, North Carolina, the Wright brothers made the first powered, controlled and sustained flights of a heavier-than-air machine, after years of glider tests. Balloons and gliders had flown before; the qualifiers are kept. The length of the first flight is from S59.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。1903 年 12 月 17 日，莱特兄弟在多年滑翔试验之后，于北卡罗来纳州斩魔山（Kill Devil Hills）附近完成了重于空气的飞行器第一次有动力、可操纵、持续的飞行。气球和滑翔机更早就飞上过天；这些限定词保留。首飞时长见 S59。

text.en: SG101, Government of Singapore. How Singapore’s Changi Airport Came To Be.
text.zh: 新加坡政府 SG101《新加坡樟宜机场是怎样建成的》（How Singapore’s Changi Airport Came To Be）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Site preparation began in 1975 and involved demolishing 558 buildings and exhuming 4,096 graves; Changi began commercial operations on 1 July 1981 and was officially opened on 29 December 1981. The counts are of buildings and graves, not of households or people; the land clearing and the sea reclamation figures on the page are not used.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。场地准备于 1975 年开始，涉及拆除 558 座建筑、迁掘 4,096 座坟墓；樟宜于 1981 年 7 月 1 日开始商业运营，1981 年 12 月 29 日正式开幕。这些数字统计的是建筑和坟墓，不是住户或人数；该页的土地清理与填海面积不采用。

text.en: Rebecca Tan. How Changi Airport Came To Be. BiblioAsia (National Library Board), vol. 17 issue 3, October–December 2021 (published 10 October 2021): sections “Changi Versus Paya Lebar” and “Building Changi”.
text.zh: Rebecca Tan《樟宜机场是怎样建成的》（How Changi Airport Came To Be），国家图书馆管理局 BiblioAsia 第 17 卷第 3 期，2021 年 10–12 月（2021 年 10 月 10 日发表）：“樟宜对巴耶利峇”“建设樟宜”两节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Planners considered both expanding Paya Lebar and building at Changi, weighing capacity, land for growth, flight paths and aircraft noise over built-up areas; the opening paragraph of “Building Changi” gives the same building and grave counts as S22 and is used to cross-check them.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。规划者既考虑扩建巴耶利峇，也考虑在樟宜新建，权衡了容量、扩展用地、航路和飞机噪音对住宅区的影响；“建设樟宜”首段给出与 S22 相同的建筑和坟墓数字，用于交叉核对。

text.en: Urban Redevelopment Authority. Former Kallang Airport Conservation Area: The History.
text.zh: 市区重建局《前加冷机场保留区》（Former Kallang Airport Conservation Area）：历史一节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Kallang Airport was officially opened on 12 June 1937; in 1955 its role as Singapore’s civil airport passed to Paya Lebar. The page’s period adjectives are not repeated.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。加冷机场于 1937 年 6 月 12 日正式开幕；1955 年，新加坡民用机场的功能转到巴耶利峇。该页带有时代色彩的形容词不采用。

text.en: SG101, Government of Singapore. Official Opening of Paya Lebar Airport.
text.zh: 新加坡政府 SG101《巴耶利峇机场正式开幕》（Official Opening of Paya Lebar Airport）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27, first paragraph: Paya Lebar Airport was officially opened on 20 August 1955. No separate date for the start of operations is given here or added.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读，第一段：巴耶利峇机场于 1955 年 8 月 20 日正式开幕。这里没有另给开始运营的日期，本主题也不另加。

text.en: TU Delft OpenCourseWare. Main Takeaways on Wing Structures (course reading 3.4.6): paragraphs on ribs, spars and the torsion box.
text.zh: 代尔夫特理工大学开放课程《机翼结构要点》（Main Takeaways on Wing Structures，课程读物 3.4.6）：翼肋、翼梁、扭力盒各段。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Ribs give the wing its airfoil shape; spars run along the span and carry the bending loads; two spars, the skin panels and the ribs at their ends together form a closed box; real structures vary with the design. The page is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; its facts are paraphrased and none of its figures are used.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。翼肋给机翼以翼型；翼梁沿翼展延伸，承担弯曲载荷；两根翼梁、蒙皮板和两端的翼肋合成一个封闭的盒；真实结构随设计而不同。该页许可为 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0；只转述事实，不使用其中任何图。

text.en: Singapore Airlines. SIA Group Operating Profit Tops $2.1 Billion. News release No. 02/08, 13 May 2008: printed page 3 (PDF page 3), Fleet and Route Development.
text.zh: 新加坡航空公司新闻稿第 02/08 号（2008 年 5 月 13 日），印刷第 3 页（PDF 第 3 页）“机队与航线发展”一节。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. The airline took delivery of its first A380 on 15 October 2007 and began commercial services with it to Sydney on 25 October 2007. Delivery and the start of passenger services are kept as two events. No description of the first flight beyond this is used.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。该公司于 2007 年 10 月 15 日接收首架 A380，2007 年 10 月 25 日用它开始飞往悉尼的商业服务。交付和投入客运作为两个事件分开写；除此以外不采用对首航的其他描述。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center. Conformal Mapping.
text.zh: NASA 格伦研究中心《保角映射》（Conformal Mapping）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. The Joukowski transformation f = ζ + 1/ζ maps a circle, and the ideal flow around it, onto an airfoil; the Kutta condition fixes the circulation so that the flow leaves the sharp trailing edge smoothly. It is an ideal-flow method and does not calculate viscous separation or stall. Used as the mathematical basis of S58; no program code was copied.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。茹科夫斯基变换 f = ζ + 1/ζ 把一个圆以及圆周围的理想流映射成翼型及其周围的流；库塔条件确定环量，使气流平顺地离开尖后缘。这是理想流方法，不计算黏性分离或失速。作为 S58 的数学依据；未复制任何程序代码。

text.en: Atlas design study for this topic (docs/45; generic, no manufacturer, model or airline): a generic twin-engine airliner, a separate two-spar wing box, a separate two-spool turbofan cutaway and an airfoil experiment with an original illustrative flow model. Design values: airliner nominally about 40 m long, 36 m span and 12 m high, drawn ten times smaller; wing box with two spars, skin and three ribs (a drawing choice); turbofan with one fan, separate compressor and turbine rotors, the fan shaft inside the hollow core shaft; display rotation 30 rpm for the fan, fan shaft and fan turbine and 45 rpm for the core shaft, compressor rotor and core turbine, and 30 rpm for the airliner’s fans (slowed for reading, not real speeds); control-surface poses: ailerons ±12° in opposite directions, elevators 10° up, rudder 10°, bank 20° about the airliner’s centre, flaps moved back 0.04 m and down 20°, slats forward 0.025 m, the spoiler raised 35° in the high-lift pose; in the level-flight beat the airliner makes a non-looping 0.3 m forward illustration over 2 s using eased keyframes; this is not a constant-speed or acceleration calculation; force-diagram arrows drawn as lift = weight = 1,000 N and thrust = drag = 100 N for proportion only, the two pairs at different arrow scales so that both read (lengths compare within a pair, not between pairs). The wing box's ribs and skin use a generic cambered drawing section (2 % camber, 12 % thick), not the experiment's section. Airfoil experiment: a symmetric Joukowski section (ε = 0.08, generating circle radius R = 1.08), chord c = 1 m, reference area S = 2 m² (the drawn 0.12 m depth is only a cut slice); angle of attack −20° to 20° in 4° steps (default 4°); airspeed relative to the air 0, 20, 30, 40, 50 or 60 m/s (default 40); altitude 0, 5,000 or 10,000 m (default 0). Model: Cl = A sin α with A = 8πR/C = 6.7486 up to |α| = 12° (attached ideal flow, Kutta condition); beyond 12° an illustrative rule: Cl falls linearly to 0.85 of the 12° value at 16° and to 0.60 at 20°, mirrored for negative angles; air density from the S11 troposphere formulas; q = ½ ρ V²; L = q S Cl. Results at 4° and 40 m/s: Cl = 0.471; at 0 m ρ = 1.227 kg/m³, q = 981.3 Pa, L = 923.9 N; at 5,000 m ρ = 0.738 kg/m³, L = 555.6 N; at 10,000 m ρ = 0.414 kg/m³, L = 311.8 N; at 20 m/s and 0 m L = 231.0 N (exactly a quarter). Cl at 0, 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20°: 0, 0.471, 0.939, 1.403, 1.193, 0.842. A fixed-density check with ρ = 1.225 kg/m³ gives q = 980 Pa and L = 922.7 N at 4° and 40 m/s; that number belongs to the engine tests, not to this topic’s pages.
text.zh: 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究（docs/45；通用对象，不对应任何制造商、型号或航空公司）：一架通用双发客机、一个独立的双梁翼盒、一台独立的两转子涡扇剖面，以及一个使用原创示意气流模型的翼型实验。设计值：客机名义尺寸约长 40 米、翼展 36 米、高 12 米，按十分之一画出；翼盒有两根翼梁、蒙皮和三道翼肋（三道是绘图选择）；涡扇有一个风扇、分开的压气机转子和涡轮转子，风扇轴在空心的核心轴里面；画面转速：风扇、风扇轴、风扇涡轮每分钟 30 转，核心轴、压气机转子、核心涡轮每分钟 45 转，客机两个风扇每分钟 30 转（为便于观看而放慢，不是真实转速）；操纵面姿态：两侧副翼反向各 12°，升降舵上偏 10°，方向舵 10°，绕客机中心倾斜 20°，襟翼后移 0.04 米再下偏 20°，缝翼前移 0.025 米，高升力姿态中扰流板抬起 35°；水平飞行那一拍里，客机用引擎的缓动关键帧在 2 秒内向前平移 0.3 米，播放一次后停住；这只是运动示意，不计算匀速或加速度；四力示意箭头按升力 = 重力 = 1,000 牛、推力 = 阻力 = 100 牛的比例画，只用于构图，两对箭头的缩放不同，便于都看得清（只在同一对之内比较长短，不在两对之间比较）。翼盒的翼肋和蒙皮用一个通用的有弯度绘图剖面（弯度 2%、厚度 12%），不是实验翼型。翼型实验：对称茹科夫斯基翼型（ε = 0.08，生成圆半径 R = 1.08），弦长 c = 1 米，参考面积 S = 2 平方米（画出的 0.12 米厚度只是截取的一段）；迎角 −20° 至 20°，每档 4°（默认 4°）；相对空气速度 0、20、30、40、50 或 60 米每秒（默认 40）；高度 0、5,000 或 10,000 米（默认 0）。模型：|α| 不超过 12° 时 Cl = A sin α，A = 8πR/C = 6.7486（附着的理想流，库塔条件）；超过 12° 用示意规则：16° 时降到 12° 值的 0.85，20° 时降到 0.60，之间线性，负角镜像；空气密度用 S11 的对流层公式；q = ½ ρ V²；L = q S Cl。迎角 4°、速度 40 米每秒时的结果：Cl = 0.471；0 米 ρ = 1.227 kg/m³，q = 981.3 帕，L = 923.9 牛；5,000 米 ρ = 0.738 kg/m³，L = 555.6 牛；10,000 米 ρ = 0.414 kg/m³，L = 311.8 牛；速度 20 米每秒、0 米时 L = 231.0 牛（恰为四分之一）。0、4、8、12、16、20° 的 Cl：0、0.471、0.939、1.403、1.193、0.842。用固定密度 ρ = 1.225 kg/m³ 的检验得 q = 980 帕、L = 922.7 牛（4°、40 米每秒）；这个数属于引擎测试，不出现在本主题页面上。

note.en: Not a measurement and not the performance of any aircraft or engine. Inputs and equations: S4 (lift equation), S11 (atmosphere, constants as printed), S57 (Joukowski mapping and Kutta condition); geometry from C = 2 − zLE with zLE = −(1 + 2ε) − 1/(1 + 2ε). The flow is inviscid and two-dimensional: no viscosity, Reynolds- or Mach-number effects, finite-wing correction, drag or engine model. The 12° boundary and the 0.85 / 0.60 knots are a teaching rule, not a measured polar or a universal stall angle (S3: the stall angle must be found by test for each wing and set of conditions); beyond 12° the stage shows dashed separation lines as a diagram only, and no flow paths or pressure. The pressure plot uses the same ideal field; integrating its surface pressure reproduces Cl and gives almost no force along the stream, which is a self-consistency check of the inviscid model and not a statement that real drag is zero. Streamline particles are slowed 80 times in the picture. The airliner and engine are drawn for structure and topology only; their parts, blade counts, rib count, angles and rotation speeds are drawing choices.
note.zh: 不是实测值，也不是任何飞机或发动机的性能。输入与方程：S4（升力方程）、S11（大气，常数照原文）、S57（茹科夫斯基映射与库塔条件）；几何量 C = 2 − zLE，zLE = −(1 + 2ε) − 1/(1 + 2ε)。气流是无黏、二维的：不含黏性、雷诺数或马赫数效应、有限翼展修正、阻力或发动机模型。12° 分界和 0.85、0.60 两个折点是教学规则，不是实测极曲线，也不是通用的失速角（S3：失速点要针对每种机翼由试验确定）；超过 12° 时舞台只画虚线分离示意，不画流线，也不算气压。气压图用的是同一个理想流场；对表面气压求积分可以还原 Cl，沿来流方向的力几乎为零，这只是无黏模型的自洽检验，不表示真实阻力为零。流线上的示踪点在画面里放慢了 80 倍。客机和发动机只画结构和拓扑；零件、叶片数、翼肋数、角度和转速都是绘图选择。

text.en: US National Park Service, Wright Brothers National Memorial. Four Powered Flights.
text.zh: 美国国家公园管理局莱特兄弟国家纪念地《四次动力飞行》（Four Powered Flights）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. On 17 December 1903 Orville Wright’s first flight lasted 12 seconds. The distances and the times of the later flights on the page are not used.
note.zh: 2026-10-27 读。1903 年 12 月 17 日，奥维尔·莱特的第一次飞行持续 12 秒。该页其余各次飞行的距离和时长不采用。
